records.statement: SBI's DCA, card and shareholder-benefit products establish distribution mechanisms but do not disclose XRP-specific plan counts, fills, reward selections, redemptions, credited units, inventory sourcing or external venue purchases.
records.impact: Treating JPY product limits or reward face values as actual net external XRP capital would overstate demand and contaminate prediction features.
disconfirming_evidence: DCA orders can be skipped when prefunded JPY is insufficient.
Card and shareholder benefits are reward liabilities that may be fulfilled from existing dealer inventory or internal transfers.
Some benefits allow a non-crypto alternative; cardholders select only one reward asset.
required_data: SBI VC Trade XRP-specific DCA active-plan count and monthly executed JPY/XRP units.
Card XRP selection share, points accrued and XRP units credited.
Shareholder program eligible-holder counts, coupon redemptions and XRP units credited.
SBI VC Trade treasury inventory and external spot/OTC procurement reconciliation.
